repository_summary.name: local-agent
repository_summary.description: A security-focused CLI wrapper around Ollama for evidence-gated question answering over local documents. Implements a two-pass LLM orchestration model (tool-selection then answer-only), sandboxed file access with typed error codes, markdown indexing with heading-aware chunking, hybrid lexical+vector retrieval, durable memory, citation validation, and full run-level audit logging. Intentionally narrow: one tool (read_text_file), one job (evidence-constrained QA), fail-closed behavior on missing evidence.
external_integrations: Ollama (HTTP API for generation and embedding)

atomic_skills.skill: Designing multi-subcommand CLI entry points with argparse
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py defines 7 subcommands (chat, ask, index, query, embed, memory, doctor) with global flags (--workroot, --ollama-base-url) and per-command options (--big, --fast, --full, --rebuild, --json, etc.).

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing typed error codes for deterministic failure signaling
atomic_skills.evidence: 13+ distinct error codes (PATH_DENIED, FILE_NOT_FOUND, AMBIGUOUS_PATH, EVIDENCE_NOT_ACQUIRED, EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED, SECOND_PASS_FORMAT_VIOLATION, INVALID_ARGS, FILE_READ_ERROR, FILE_EMPTY, TOOL_ERROR, EVIDENCE_INVALID, UNEXPECTED_TOOL_CALL_SECOND_PASS, INTERNAL_ERROR, CONFIG_ERROR, DOCTOR_*) used throughout agent/__main__.py and agent/tools.py. Each code maps to a specific failure scenario with structured error messages in run JSON logs.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing configuration precedence chains across multiple override levels
atomic_skills.evidence: Ollama base URL: CLI --ollama-base-url > LOCAL_AGENT_OLLAMA_BASE_URL env > OLLAMA_BASE_URL env > config value > default. Workroot: CLI flag > LOCAL_AGENT_WORKROOT env > config workroot > config_root or cwd. Implemented in agent/ollama_config.py and agent/runtime_config.py with tests in tests/test_ollama_config.py and tests/test_root_resolution.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Structuring a Python package as an executable module with entry point
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py provides main() entry point. pyproject.toml registers 'local-agent = agent.__main__:main' console script. Package installable via pip install -e '.[dev]'.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing filesystem path containment checks with lexical and resolved validation
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/tools.py resolve_and_validate_path() performs two-layer validation: lexical containment via _is_within() before file existence check, then re-checks containment after Path.resolve(strict=True) to catch symlink escapes. Tests in tests/test_tools_security.py validate traversal denial, escape detection, and ambiguity.

atomic_skills.skill: Defending against symlink escape attacks in file-read operations
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/tools.py resolve_and_validate_path() calls Path.resolve(strict=True) after initial lexical check, then re-validates _is_within() on the resolved path. If resolved path escapes the allowed root, sets escape_seen=True and returns PATH_DENIED. Tested in tests/test_tools_security.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing deny-by-default security policies for file access (hidden paths, absolute paths, extension filtering)
atomic_skills.evidence: ReadTextFilePolicy dataclass in agent/tools.py enforces deny_absolute_paths, deny_hidden_paths, and allowed_exts={.md,.txt,.json} by default. Each denial produces a typed error. configs/default.yaml declares security.deny_absolute_paths: true, deny_hidden_paths: true, allow_any_path: false. Tests in tests/test_tools_security.py and tests/test_evidence_read_policy.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing bare-filename search with multi-root traversal and ambiguity detection
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/tools.py resolve_and_validate_path() bare-filename mode iterates all allowed_roots, collects valid matches, deduplicates by resolved path, and returns AMBIGUOUS_PATH if multiple unique matches exist. Tests verify single-match resolution, zero-match FILE_NOT_FOUND, and multi-match ambiguity.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing two-pass LLM orchestration (tool-selection pass then answer-only pass)
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py run_ask_one_tool() implements Pass 1 (model chooses to call read_text_file or answer directly) and Pass 2 (answer-only, no tool calls allowed). Pass 2 uses different system prompt, validates no tool-call JSON in response, and enforces format constraints. Full flow logged to run JSON.

atomic_skills.skill: Parsing structured JSON tool calls from unstructured LLM output with strict-then-fallback strategy
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/protocol.py try_parse_tool_call() first attempts json.loads() on full text (strict mode); on failure, falls back to _find_first_json_object_span() which scans for brace-balanced JSON objects while tracking string/escape state. Captures trailing text after the JSON object. Tests in tests/test_protocol_tool_call_parsing.py cover strict parse, prefix extraction, trailing text, and malformed input.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing evidence-gated answer generation with fail-closed behavior
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py evidence_required_by_question() uses regex-based heuristics to detect when evidence is required. If evidence is required but not acquired (no tool call, tool error, invalid result), the system fails with EVIDENCE_NOT_ACQUIRED rather than guessing. Tests in tests/test_phase3_ask_grounded.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Detecting and retrying LLM output format violations with escalating strictness
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py second_pass_violations() detects markdown tables via pipe-and-separator regex. If only MISSING_SCOPE_FOOTER, auto-appends footer. If other violations, retries with strict_rewrite_tables=True system prompt. If retry still fails, errors with SECOND_PASS_FORMAT_VIOLATION. Full retry metadata logged in run JSON.

atomic_skills.skill: Integrating with Ollama HTTP API for text generation and embedding
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py calls Ollama /api/generate for chat/ask passes. agent/embedders/ollama.py calls /api/embeddings for vector embedding. Both handle HTTP errors, timeouts, and endpoint validation. agent/ollama_config.py normalizes and validates base URLs (scheme, host, no-path enforcement).

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing content-based model routing with keyword triggers
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py select_models() routes between model_fast and model_big based on big_triggers keyword list (deep, long, essay, synthesize, thorough, etc.) matched against the question text. Supports force overrides (--fast, --big, --full) and prefer_fast configuration.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing auto-reread logic for truncated file evidence
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py run_ask_one_tool() detects truncated evidence after Pass 1, computes reread target via compute_reread_max_chars() (capped at READ_TEXT_FILE_HARD_CAP=200000), and issues a second read_text_file call. classify_truncated_evidence_issue() categorizes remaining truncation.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing heading-aware markdown chunking with hierarchical heading paths
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/chunking.py chunk_markdown_obsidian_v1() tracks heading hierarchy (H1 > H2 > H3 etc.) across chunks, splits on heading boundaries, and records heading_path (e.g., 'H1: Title > H2: Section') for each chunk. Tests in tests/test_phase2_chunking.py verify heading tracking, boundary splitting, and overlap behavior.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing fixed-window text chunking with configurable overlap
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/chunking.py chunk_markdown_fixed_window_v1() splits text into chunks of max_chars with overlap characters carried from the previous chunk boundary. Uses sentenceish boundary detection to avoid mid-word splits. BOM stripping included.

atomic_skills.skill: Building a SQLite-backed document index with positional text search
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/index_db.py implements multi-table schema (sources, docs, chunks) with query_chunks_lexical() using instr(lower(text), lower(query)) for position-based matching, sorted by match position and chunk size. Tests in tests/test_phase2_query.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Parsing YAML frontmatter from markdown documents
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/chunking.py split_frontmatter() detects and extracts YAML frontmatter delimited by --- markers. agent/indexer.py FrontmatterParseResult captures parsed YAML fields. Frontmatter is stripped before chunking.

atomic_skills.skill: Designing SQLite schema migrations with version tracking
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/index_db.py init_db() checks PRAGMA user_version, applies migrations v1→v2 (adds scheme, heading_path, chunk_key columns) and v2→v3 (creates meta table, backfills chunk_keys via SHA-256 hashing), commits after each migration. Tested in tests/test_phase2_indexing.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing incremental document upsert with content fingerprinting
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/indexer.py index_sources() computes SHA-256 for each document, skips re-indexing if fingerprint unchanged, and tracks IndexSummary (docs added, updated, unchanged, chunks replaced). Chunk keys are derived from content hashes for stable identity.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing local sentence-transformer embedding with CUDA/CPU device selection
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/embedders/torch_embedder.py TorchEmbedder supports device='auto'/'cpu'/'cuda', dtype selection (float16/float32), batch processing, pooling='mean', normalize=True, offline_only mode, and local_model_path override. Tests in tests/test_torch_embedder.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Storing and retrieving vector embeddings as f32 little-endian blobs in SQLite
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/embedding_fingerprint.py pack_vector_f32_le() converts float arrays to little-endian binary blobs. agent/embeddings_db.py stores blobs in embeddings table, retrieves and unpacks via struct for cosine similarity computation. Tests in tests/test_embeddings_db.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing hybrid lexical + vector retrieval with rank-based fusion
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/retrieval.py retrieve() runs lexical search (Borda-like scoring: 1.0 - (rank-1)/count) and vector search (cosine similarity scaled to [0,1]) independently, then fuses via simple_union: average score if in both, single score if in one, sorted by method (both first) then score descending. Tests in tests/test_phase3_retrieval.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing cosine similarity with heap-based top-k candidate selection
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/retrieval.py _compute_vector_candidates() computes cosine similarity (dot product / norms, or just dot product for normalized vectors), maintains a heapq min-heap of size fetch_k to efficiently select top candidates without sorting all vectors.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing orphan embedding pruning
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/embeddings_db.py delete_orphan_embeddings() removes embeddings whose chunk_keys no longer exist in the index. agent/phase3.py run_embed_phase() orchestrates pruning after embed updates. Tests in tests/test_embeddings_db.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Computing runtime fingerprints to detect model and configuration drift
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/embed_runtime_fingerprint.py build_torch_runtime_fingerprint() and build_ollama_runtime_fingerprint() hash model files and config parameters. agent/phase3.py compares stored fingerprint vs current to detect stale embeddings requiring rebuild. Tests in tests/test_embed_runtime_fingerprint.py and tests/test_phase3_fingerprint.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Parsing structured citation markers from LLM output via regex
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/citation_audit.py parse_citations() extracts [source:rel_path|chunk_key] markers from model-generated text using compiled regex patterns. ParsedCitation dataclass captures path, chunk_key, and raw text. Tests in tests/test_citation_audit.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Validating LLM citations against evidence snapshots with heading normalization and prefix matching
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/citation_audit.py validate_citations() checks citations against top_n evidence chunks. Supports three matching modes: exact (full heading path match), prefix (cited heading is prefix of actual heading), and ignore (report mismatch without invalidating). _normalize_heading_segment() collapses whitespace, strips trailing punctuation, and handles colon-separated heading prefixes.

atomic_skills.skill: Generating evidence scope footers for provenance tracking in LLM output
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/citation_audit.py format_citation_validation_footer() and agent/__main__.py ensure_canonical_scope_footer_tail() produce scope footers like 'Scope: full evidence from read_text_file (chars_returned/chars_full), sha256=...' appended to every answer. Tests in tests/test_scope_footer.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Logging full run metadata to structured JSON for post-hoc audit
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py run_ask_one_tool() writes runs/<run_id>/run.json containing mode, question, model selection, raw model responses (with thinking stripped), tool trace, evidence status/metadata, retry info, error codes, timings, and resolved paths. OPERATOR_QUICKREF.md documents inspection workflow.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing typed durable memory records with constrained vocabularies
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/memory_db.py defines ALLOWED_MEMORY_TYPES={preference, project_state, constraint, workflow_rule, user_fact} and ALLOWED_MEMORY_SOURCES={manual, derived_from_evidence}. add_memory() validates type and source before insert. Schema includes memory and memory_evidence tables with foreign key cascade. Tests in test files.

atomic_skills.skill: Linking memory records to evidence chunks with referential integrity
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/memory_db.py add_memory() inserts into memory_evidence table linking memory_id to chunk_keys. If source='derived_from_evidence', at least one chunk_key is required. Foreign key ON DELETE CASCADE enforces cleanup.

atomic_skills.skill: Normalizing and validating URLs with scheme enforcement and structural constraints
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/ollama_config.py normalize_ollama_base_url() enforces http/https scheme, rejects credentials, rejects non-empty path/params/query/fragment, strips trailing slash. Tests in tests/test_ollama_config.py cover valid inputs, path rejection, missing scheme, etc.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing YAML-backed runtime configuration with nested section access
atomic_skills.evidence: configs/default.yaml defines model routing, security policy, phase2 indexing, and phase3 embedding/retrieval/memory settings in nested YAML. Configuration loaded at startup via PyYAML, with dotted-path access for nested keys throughout agent modules.

atomic_skills.skill: Resolving workroot and database paths relative to configuration root
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/runtime_config.py resolves workspace_root and security_root from config. agent/tools.py configure_tool_security() resolves allowed_roots relative to workspace_root/security_root. Phase 2/3 database paths resolved relative to workroot. Tests in tests/test_root_resolution.py and tests/test_config_workspace_resolution.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Designing an abstract embedder interface with pluggable provider implementations
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/embedder.py defines abstract Embedder base class with embed_texts(), embed_dim, and runtime_fingerprint() contract. agent/embedders/torch_embedder.py and agent/embedders/ollama.py implement the interface. agent/phase3.py create_embedder() selects provider via configuration.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing preflight health checks (doctor command) with structured diagnostics
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py cmd_doctor() runs checks for Ollama reachability, config validity, source directory existence, index schema version, embedding staleness, and memory-evidence dangling references. DoctorCheckResult dataclass captures check name, status, and message. Supports --json output. Tests in tests/test_doctor.py and tests/test_phase3_embed_doctor.py.

atomic_skills.skill: Writing unittest-based tests for security boundary conditions
atomic_skills.evidence: tests/test_tools_security.py tests path traversal denial, hidden path denial, symlink escape detection, absolute path denial, extension filtering, bare-filename ambiguity, and allow_any_path override. tests/test_evidence_read_policy.py tests policy enforcement combinations.

atomic_skills.skill: Writing contract-stability tests for CLI command dispatch
atomic_skills.evidence: tests/test_phase3_cli_contract.py tests command dispatch for all subcommands, argument parsing, lazy Ollama resolution, and flag behavior by patching agent.__main__.main().

atomic_skills.skill: Configuring pyproject.toml with optional dependency groups and console script entry points
atomic_skills.evidence: pyproject.toml defines [project.optional-dependencies] torch-embed (torch, transformers, sentence-transformers) and dev (pytest>=7). Registers console script local-agent = agent.__main__:main.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing curated release zip creation with inclusion/exclusion rules
atomic_skills.evidence: scripts/make_release_zip.py _collect_release_files() curates included files (agent/, configs/, specific root files), excludes build artifacts (.git, .venv, __pycache__, dist/, build/, runs/), supports --include-workroot for optional payload and --dry-run for preview.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing build artifact cleanup automation
atomic_skills.evidence: scripts/clean_artifacts.py recursively removes __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .pyc files, dist/, build/ with --dry-run preview mode.

atomic_skills.skill: Configuring devcontainer with named volume mounts for persistent external storage
atomic_skills.evidence: .devcontainer/devcontainer.json mounts named volume 'local-agent-workroot' at /workspaces/local-agent-workroot, sets LOCAL_AGENT_WORKROOT env var, and runs post-create setup (pip install, directory creation).

atomic_skills.skill: Writing operator-facing documentation with error code catalogs and troubleshooting workflows
atomic_skills.evidence: OPERATOR_QUICKREF.md documents all CLI commands, file path behavior modes, typed error codes with triggers and resolutions, run JSON inspection workflow, and security sanity checks. SECURITY.md provides a manual verification checklist.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing text preprocessing pipelines for embedding (BOM stripping, whitespace normalization, heading removal)
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/embedding_fingerprint.py normalize_embedding_text() and preprocess_chunk_text() strip BOM, normalize whitespace, and remove markdown heading markers. preprocess_query_text() applies query-specific normalization. compute_embed_sig() generates deterministic signatures for change detection.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing evidence requirement detection via regex-based question classification
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py evidence_required_by_question() uses compiled regex patterns to detect file extensions, explicit read requests, summarization patterns, and content queries. Evidence requirement is also upgraded to true if model emits a tool call in Pass 1.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing evidence validation with typed field checks and metadata consistency enforcement
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py validates evidence objects for required fields (path, sha256, chars_full, chars_returned, truncated, text), type correctness, character count consistency, and empty file detection for summarization tasks. Invalid evidence produces EVIDENCE_INVALID error code.

atomic_skills.skill: Stripping LLM thinking/reasoning tokens from logged responses
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/__main__.py strips message.thinking content from raw model responses before writing to run JSON, preserving audit integrity while removing internal reasoning artifacts.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing JSON-object span detection with string/escape-aware brace tracking
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/protocol.py _find_first_json_object_span() scans character-by-character tracking brace depth, in_string state, and escape flag to find the first complete JSON object. Handles nested objects, strings containing braces, and escaped characters.

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing foreign key enforcement and cascade deletes in SQLite
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/index_db.py, agent/embeddings_db.py, and agent/memory_db.py all enable PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON and use ON DELETE CASCADE for referential integrity (e.g., memory_evidence references memory, chunks reference docs).

atomic_skills.skill: Implementing Windows path anchor detection for cross-platform security
atomic_skills.evidence: agent/tools.py _has_windows_anchor() detects Windows drive letters and UNC paths to deny them on any platform, ensuring consistent security behavior regardless of OS.

primary_sources: Python source code in agent/ (20 modules, 8091 lines)
Unit tests in tests/ (21 test files, 164 tests)
Package metadata in pyproject.toml and requirements.txt
evidence_quality_notes: Most skills are supported by both implementation code AND dedicated test coverage, yielding strong evidence.
Skills related to LLM output handling (S49, S12) rely on code inspection of __main__.py where the logic is dense but testable via contract tests.
The Ollama integration (S13) is evidenced by HTTP client code and config normalization but actual end-to-end LLM interaction cannot be verified without a running Ollama instance.
The devcontainer skill (S44) is evidenced by configuration only; actual container behavior depends on external runtime.

ambiguities_or_borderline_calls.note: The lexical search uses instr() for positional matching rather than SQLite FTS5, so 'FTS implementation' would overclaim. Described as 'positional text search' instead.
ambiguities_or_borderline_calls.resolution: Downgraded wording to avoid implying FTS5 module usage.

ambiguities_or_borderline_calls.note: The torch embedder supports device='auto'/'cuda' with dtype selection, but whether CUDA is actually exercised depends on the runtime environment. The code is CUDA-ready but we cannot confirm GPU usage from the repository alone.
ambiguities_or_borderline_calls.resolution: Described as 'CUDA/CPU device selection' rather than 'GPU-accelerated embedding'.

ambiguities_or_borderline_calls.note: The two-pass ask flow and format violation retry logic are implemented in __main__.py but the tests primarily use mocked/patched dispatch rather than full LLM integration. The orchestration code is present and structured, but integration testing evidence is moderate.
ambiguities_or_borderline_calls.resolution: Included at strong evidence level because the orchestration logic is concretely implemented and structurally verifiable even without live LLM tests.

ambiguities_or_borderline_calls.note: Windows anchor detection (_has_windows_anchor) and OS-agnostic path resolution are implemented, but the test suite likely runs on a single platform. Cross-platform correctness is designed-for but not exhaustively verified.
ambiguities_or_borderline_calls.resolution: Included the Windows anchor detection skill (S52) since the implementation is concrete, but noted the testing limitation.

ambiguities_or_borderline_calls.note: The memory system (memory_db.py) implements full CRUD, typed records, and evidence linking, but the tests directory does not contain a dedicated test_memory_db.py file. Evidence linking and dangling reference detection are implemented in code but test coverage may be indirect via doctor checks.
ambiguities_or_borderline_calls.resolution: Included at strong evidence level for the implementation but noted that dedicated memory unit tests may be exercised through integration paths.

ambiguities_or_borderline_calls.note: The v1→v2→v3 migration in index_db.py is concrete but limited to one database. Calling it a 'migration framework' would overclaim. It is a schema migration implementation specific to the index database.
ambiguities_or_borderline_calls.resolution: Described as 'designing SQLite schema migrations with version tracking' rather than 'building a migration framework'.

main_takeaway: This repository demonstrates a disciplined, security-first approach to building a local LLM-powered QA system. The strongest and most distinctive skill signals are: (1) layered filesystem sandboxing with typed denial codes and symlink defense, (2) two-pass LLM orchestration with evidence gating and fail-closed behavior, (3) structured JSON tool-call parsing with graceful fallback strategies, (4) hybrid retrieval with fingerprint-based staleness detection, and (5) comprehensive audit logging. The implementation consistently prioritizes explicit contracts (typed errors, schema versions, evidence metadata) over implicit behavior, and fail-closed correctness over best-effort flexibility. These skills translate directly to roles involving secure tooling design, integration-aware systems, CLI-first workflows, and deterministic automation.

skill_clusters.note: Tight cluster around read-only file access policy enforcement with multiple defensive layers.
Evidence-gated two-pass flow with structured parsing, format enforcement, and retry logic.
Phase 2 pipeline: markdown → chunks → SQLite index with incremental updates.
Phase 3 pipeline: embedder abstraction → vector storage → fusion retrieval with staleness detection.
Output provenance: citation parsing, validation, scope footers, and run JSON logging.
Multi-level configuration precedence, URL validation, and path resolution.
Subcommand CLI, typed errors, entry points, doctor checks, and packaging.
Security boundary tests and CLI contract stability tests.
Typed durable memory with evidence linking and referential integrity.
Release automation, artifact cleanup, devcontainer config, operator docs.

transferable_signal_notes: Filesystem sandboxing skills (S05-S08, S52) transfer directly to any security-sensitive tooling, plugin systems, or file-processing pipelines where untrusted paths must be constrained.
Two-pass LLM orchestration (S09, S11, S12) signals experience designing structured AI workflows with explicit control flow, not just prompt engineering.
Typed error codes (S02) and evidence validation (S48) demonstrate a preference for deterministic, debuggable systems over opaque failure modes—highly relevant for production tooling and API design.
Hybrid retrieval with fingerprint staleness detection (S24, S27) signals understanding of both IR fundamentals and operational concerns (cache invalidation, model drift).

The consistent use of SQLite across three databases with schema migration (S20), foreign keys (S51), and typed metadata storage demonstrates practical relational database design without over-engineering.
Abstract embedder interface (S37) with two concrete implementations shows familiarity with provider-agnostic design patterns applicable to any pluggable integration.
Run JSON audit logging (S31) translates directly to compliance, debugging, and observability requirements in production systems.
overclaim_risks: Do not claim 'machine learning engineering' from this repository—embedding usage is applied (model invocation and vector operations) rather than ML model development.
Do not claim 'distributed systems' from Ollama HTTP integration—this is a single-client, single-server integration pattern.
Do not claim 'full-text search expertise' from the positional substring matching—it uses instr() rather than dedicated FTS engines.
Do not claim 'cross-platform development' solely from Windows anchor detection—OS-agnostic intent is visible but test-verified behavior is likely single-platform.
Do not claim 'RAG system architecture' as a broad capability—this implements one specific, intentionally narrow RAG pattern (single-tool, single-document, evidence-gated).
dedupe_notes_for_cross_repo_merge: S01 (CLI with argparse): Likely recurrent across Python CLI projects. Merge by keeping the most feature-rich instance.
S03 (config precedence chains): May appear in other projects with env-var overrides. Merge if identical pattern.
S20 (SQLite schema migrations): Check if other repos also implement manual PRAGMA user_version migrations vs using a migration library.
S35 (YAML config loading): Generic skill, likely shared. Keep the instance with most complex nested structure.
S41 (pyproject.toml packaging): Standard Python packaging skill. Merge across repos, keep version with optional dependency groups.
S44 (devcontainer setup): May recur across repos with GitHub Codespaces support. Merge by noting volume mount and env var patterns.
S39 (security boundary testing): Keep the most comprehensive test example as canonical.
